items.title: Is Visa’s AI Cybersecurity and New Markets Push Reshaping the Investment Case for Visa (V)?
items.summary: In recent days, Visa reported strong fiscal Q3 2026 results, expanded its open-source AI-powered cybersecurity framework, deepened payment security collaborations such as with Bluefin, re-entered Syria with its first live international transaction, and saw Bill Ackman’s Pershing Square add Visa to its concentrated portfolio. items.title: Bill Ackman Just Bought Visa, Mastercard, and S&P Global Stock. Each One Collects a Toll on Somebody Else's Sale.
items.summary: Pershing Square's three biggest new stakes are in companies that get paid when somebody else's customer transacts. Together, they were bigger than any single bet in the filing.

items.title: Warren Buffett Turns 96 on Sunday. His Final Berkshire Masterpiece Isn’t Winning Over Wall Street.
items.summary: Warren Buffett is getting high marks for his role as  Berkshire Hathaway’s  chairman as he approaches his 96th birthday on Sunday.  Since he stepped down as CEO at the start of the year, Buffett has remained very much in the game, including involvement in Berkshire’s share buybacks and its large  Alphabet  stake.
